source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API for jobs 11200/11210/11211/11212; WZ API for 5th-job skills and HEXA cores

counts.note: effectFrames/hitFrames count each skill once; HEXA cores share base-skill frames and contribute 0 frames, so unique counts equal totals. 179 frames are 1x1 placeholders, of which 166 belong to the three WZ-leaf V skills whose real visuals could not be fetched (see notes); the rest are genuine source placeholders.

notes: Beast Tamer job line: 11200 (1st, Bear), 11210 (2nd, Leopard), 11211 (3rd, Hawk), 11212 (4th/Hyper, Cat).
5th-job (V) skills are split across two V files: Beast's Rage and Beak Strike in Skill/40002.img, Mighty Mascot (x2 entries) and Endlessly Starving Beast in Skill/40005.img.
HEXA mastery cores (Skill/40000.img 400004531-400004546) and V-skill Boost cores (Skill/50000.img 500004150/175/192/193) are passive entries with no frames; they share their base skills' frames.
No Beast Tamer Origin skill exists in Skill/50006.img (shared HEXA Origin file).

Job 11214 (candidate 6th-job skillbook) was tested: skillbook fetch failed 3/3 (IncompleteRead) and the WZ Skill/11214.img/skill listing returns HTTP 500 — but no 11214xxx skill IDs exist in String/Skill.img (15,751 IDs), so there is no evidence of a 6th-job skillbook for Beast Tamer; treated as not existing. (Note: the API also returns HTTP 500 for known-nonexistent job 99999, so the 500s alone are inconclusive.)

Job 0 (Beginner/common): skillbook fetch and WZ Skill/0.img/skill listing both return HTTP 500 after retries; still unverified and out of scope regardless (generic Beginner file, not a playable class).

Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them. 13 such frames occur in the 1st-4th job skills (genuine source placeholders, mostly effect-00). The other placeholders belong to the three WZ-leaf V skills (see below).

V-skill visuals for Beast's Rage (400021134), Beak Strike (400021137) and Endlessly Starving Beast (400051080) are 1x1 placeholders only: maplestory.io /wz/img currently returns 1x1 placeholder PNGs for every image node (verified 2026-11-15 with known-good Hero Slash Blast effect/0, also 1x1). Their delay/origin metadata and names/descriptions are real. Retry when the API recovers.
Ball (projectile) layers are stored under each skill's ball list (Leopard's Roar, Formation Attack, Friend Launcher 1-4, Fire Kitty!, Meow Heal).
Beak Strike summon frames are stored grouped (stand/summoned) under its summon entry; its effect0 layer (8 frames) is stored under effect0.

skills.name: Paw Swipe
skills.description:
Attacks several enemies 3 times.
[Command]: Tap Attack Key multiple times

skills.name: Furious Strikes
skills.description:
Using Paw Swipe 4 times in a row will activate a special skill, allowing multiple follow-up hits.
[Command]: After the 3rd attack of Paw Swipe, activate it by pressing the attack key repeatedly (or holding the key down).

skills.name: Dumb Luck
skills.description: When in Bear mode, increases Knockback Resistance and Defense by a certain amount, and damage taken when hit by enemies is reduced.

skills.name: Well Fed
skills.description: Increases Max HP and INT while in Bear Mode.

skills.name: Defense Ignorance
skills.description: Ignores a portion of enemy defense and increases Attack speed while in Bear Mode.

skills.name: Fort the Brave
skills.description: Permanently increases Magic ATT while in Bear Mode.

skills.name: Bear Strength
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate, Critical Damage and Magic ATT while in Bear Mode.

skills.name: Fort Follow-Up
skills.description:
Lil Fort appears after every 4th attack to deal an additional attack.
[Command]: Attack 4 times with a Bear Mode Active Skill

skills.name: Bear Reborn
skills.description:
Allows you to resurrect while in Bear Mode. You gain invincibility as your HP recovers.
Resurrection is available when the skill icon is active in the upper right.

skills.name: Billowing Trumpet
skills.description: Enhances the spark in Majestic Trumpet to form a hellish inferno.

skills.name: Deep Breath
skills.description: The bear sucks in air to pull enemies close.

skills.name: Really Deep Breath
skills.description: The bear sucks in air to pull enemies close from the left and right.

skills.name: Majestic Trumpet
skills.description: The bear uses the power of nature to ignite a fire. Enemies caught in the blast take damage. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Lil Fort
skills.description: Summons a toy bear to just go nuts on the enemy.

skills.name: Fishy Slap
skills.description: Hold down the skill key to smack enemies with a fish.

skills.name: Bear Assault
skills.description: Focuses your attacks. You'll hit fewer enemies but deal more damage. Also increases Max HP, MP, DEF, and ignores some monster defense.

skills.name: Table Flip
skills.description: The bear goes into a rage and flips a table at the enemy.

skills.name: Leopard's Paw
skills.description:
Get a dose of Lai's muscles to knock back enemies in your path. 
[Command]: After 2 hits, combo with Leopard's Pounce
[Extra Command]: Combo with Leopard's Roar

skills.name: Skill 112100001
skills.note: No name in the skillbook or String data: String/Skill.img/112100001/name returns HTTP 404 and the ID is absent from the String/Skill.img ID list; the WZ skill node exists but carries no name. Invisible sub-skill (skillbook flags it invisible) with 5 effect + 20 hit frames.

skills.name: Leopard's Pounce
skills.description:
Dash forward and rip into enemies.
[Skill Requirement]: Leopard's Paw Lv. 1
[Command]: Triggers after 2 hits of Leopard's Paw

skills.name: Leopard's Roar
skills.description:
Roar to inflict additional damage after Leopard's Pounce. Also enhances the Damage and Number of Enemies Hit with Leopard's Paw and Leopard's Pounce.
[Command] Press the [attack key] after using Leopard's Pounce

skills.name: Macho Incarnate
skills.description: Lai shows his true form after Macho Slam, shocking and stunning all nearby enemies. Also increases the Max Enemies Hit with Macho Dance and Macho Slam.

skills.name: Thunder Trail
skills.description: Unleashes a ghostly Snow Leopard mirror image during Thunder Dash, damaging nearby enemies.

skills.name: Deadly Fangs
skills.description: Magic ATT and Final Damage are increased by the effects of Deadly Fangs.

skills.name: Leopard Hide
skills.description: Grants a chance to recover HP whenever monsters are defeated. Maximum 10% per attack. Triggers at most once per attack.

skills.name: Advanced Thunder Dash
skills.description: Travel further during Thunder Dash to deal more damage.

skills.name: Rippling Feline Muscles
skills.description: Increases Magic ATT, Intelligence, Speed, and Jump when in Snow Leopard Mode.

skills.name: Lethal Lai
skills.description:
Increases the attack count and damage of certain Snow Leopard Mode skills.
Affected Skills: Leopard's Paw, Leopard's Pounce, Leopard's Roar, Macho Dance, Macho Slam, Thunder Dash

skills.name: Leopard Reflexes
skills.description: When transformed into Snow Leopard mode, Attack Speed and Magic ATT will be increased, and a portion of Defense is ignored.

skills.name: Macho Dance
skills.description: Shoot up into the air, damaging nearby enemies. Can be chained into Macho Slam.

skills.name: Macho Slam
skills.description: Slam into enemies below you. Can be used during a jump or after Macho Dance.

skills.name: Thunder Dash
skills.description: Your snow leopard buddy dashes at the enemy, dealing damage. If the Leopard's Paw, Leopard's Pounce, Leopard's Roar, Macho Slam, or Three-Point Pounce skill are in use, they will be canceled by the activation of this skill.

skills.name: Three-Point Pounce
skills.description: The snow leopard makes a three-point attack, slashing at nearby enemies with his claws.

skills.name: Bro Attack
skills.description: Gain a chance to summon a baby snow leopard to deal extra damage when you attack. Bosses and some monsters are immune.

skills.name: Party Time
skills.description: The snow leopard charges wildly across the entire map, dealing damage.

skills.name: Formation Attack
skills.description:
Baby hawks attack in formation. 
Can be directed left or right. 
Can't be used while airborne.

skills.name: Defensive Formation
skills.description:
Eka's friends come to your aid while you're flying, attacking enemies within range.
Can only trigger while flying.

skills.name: Feather Cloak
skills.description: In Hawk mode, basic Jump and Critical Rate are increased due to the effect of Feather Cloak.

skills.name: Feather Boots
skills.description: In Hawk mode, Speed and Critical Damage are increased by the effects of Feather Boots.

skills.name: Max Mobility
skills.description: In Hawk mode, Magic ATT and Attack Speed are increased by the effects of Max Mobility. In addition, it permanently ignores a portion of enemy defense rates.

skills.name: Veteran Formation
skills.description: Improves the damage of Formation Attack. Displays the improved effect after the threshold is reached.

skills.name: Fly
skills.description:
Launch into the air with Eka to unlock additional attacks.
[Command]: Press and hold [up] + [jump] to fly. Press [down] +[jump] to land.

skills.name: Eka Glider
skills.description: Press the skill key while in the air to switch to Glider status.

skills.name: Vertical Draft
skills.description: Tap Up Arrow Key while jumping to jump even higher.

skills.name: Baby Bombers
skills.description:
Calls Eka's ground-bound allies to attack.
Can only be used while airborne.

skills.name: Raptor Talons
skills.description:
Eka's talon becomes so sharp, your ATT increases. 
Passive Effects: Adding bleeding damage to all attacks while in hawk mode.

skills.name: Hawk Flock
skills.description: Increases the speed of the entire party while in hawk mode.

skills.name: Razor Beak
skills.description: Eka's beak becomes so sharp, your whole party's ATT increases.

skills.name: Bird's-Eye View
skills.description: Eka enhances her eyesight to boost Critical Rate and Defense of nearby party members.

skills.name: Eka Express
skills.description: Creates a portal to the nearest town. All party members can use it to travel.

skills.name: Regroup
skills.description: Summons any party members on the same channel who are above Lv. 9 to your location.

skills.name: Tornado Flight
skills.description: Eka's friends stir up a tornado to attack. Hold down the skill key and press the direction keys to steer.

skills.name: Sky Walk
skills.description: Eka gives you a little lift, giving you an extra double jump.

skills.name: Baby Bombers
skills.description:
Calls Eka's ground-bound allies to attack.
Can only be used while airborne.

skills.name: Beast's Rage
skills.description:
Paeon ferociously combats the enemies of the forest, attacking consecutively without mercy.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.description: Calls forth Penni's full potential to greatly enhance Peck. For the duration of the skill, Peck becomes Beak Strike, causing it to become AoE and deal significantly more damage. Unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: PARTIAL — all frames on disk are 1x1 placeholders: maplestory.io /wz/img currently returns 1x1 placeholder PNGs for every image node (verified with known-good Hero Slash Blast effect/0, also 1x1); job 40002 skillbook download fails (HTTP 520/500) and job 40005 truncates at ~484 MB before this skill; JSON image nodes return HTTP 500/timeout. skills.name: Mighty Mascot
skills.description: Eskalade that became a mascot unleashes his true power to carry out a powerful joint attack with Angelic Buster. While casting, you are immune to knockback, immune to debilitating status conditions, and unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Endlessly Starving Beast
skills.description: Summon a ravenous beast from the Abyssal depths and command it to devour everything in its path. From the moment the depths open, there's a certain delay until the beast arrives, but successful use of Specter's Force skills can hasten its arrival. The Endlessly Starving Beast is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.
